scope: Unmodified full Circuit JSON capture from the reference-board TSX run. All 163 components, 170 source traces, 52 routed traces and 104 vias are retained. DDR phases completed; non-DDR routing failed. The test replays source ownership without rerouting or filtering the circuit.
geometryFrame: Board-world points in mm; right handed, +X right, +Y up, +Z above. SVG rendering handles the screen Y inversion.
